acceptance.given: A package contains declared Skill identity metadata and a canonical package name that may differ.

oracle.expected: The validator reports pass only when the canonical package name matches the declared Skill identity, and reports an identity-conflict failure when they differ.
forbidden: Accepting a package-name and Skill-identity mismatch
oracle.observable: Package-validator result and diagnostic for canonical package-name versus declared Skill-identity consistency.

acceptance.then: The package validator performs the consistency check and emits the corresponding pass or failure outcome without accepting a mismatch.
acceptance.when: The Skill package validator validates package identity metadata.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the focused package-validator test selector with a mismatched canonical package name and declared Skill identity; the selector fails if the mismatch is accepted or no identity-conflict diagnostic is emitted.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or enforce canonical package-name and declared Skill-identity consistency validation with a deterministic mismatch diagnostic.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation-only behavior; rollback restores prior package-validation behavior without changing persisted state or schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package identity validation transitions from potentially accepting a mismatch to an explicit consistency pass/fail result with a diagnostic.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The focused package-validator test selector passes for matching identity and fails deterministically for mismatched identity with the required diagnostic.
